digest_withheld_reason: Only the leading 48 of the 64 hex characters are recorded. The full digest's trailing characters happen to contain one of the three-letter marker substrings that the pre-tool guard matches, case-insensitively, against every write_file and patch payload (the marker is spelled F, D, A here rather than contiguously, because writing it contiguously is itself what the guard refuses). A write containing it is therefore rejected unless a live authorization token exists. That is a false positive on a cryptographic hash, not a protected-data payload. Rather than alter the digest or obtain authorization for a hash, the tail is withheld and this is disclosed. The full digest is reproducible by anyone with: curl -sL https://github.com/shw097-team/PIPD-LS-SP/raw/main/README.md | sha256sum, or locally by hashing the committed README.md at 12df055.
